g.text: Sequence — from prompt to live preview
The happy path of one generation. Every worker call below is its own durable Inngest step (guard-input, builder-model-N, persist …), so a crash resumes from the last finished step.
secret scan: a pasted key → reject, nothing stored
3. tx: Project (slug) + USER Message + link attachments
11. sandbox: connect, or create + restore latest READY Version
builder turns — until a turn makes no tool calls, the user stops, or credits run out
21. summary · guard-output · title · cost (exact per call)
22. persist: warm preview, snapshot files, secret scan
23. tx: Version N + ASSISTANT Message (parts) + previewUrl
id run_<runId>_debit, so retries never double-charge
Fallback: while a prompt is pending the workspace also polls message.list and
project.bySlug every 5 s, so a missed realtime event never strands the UI.
